text_block_list.text:
Do you know what the most thrilling
scene is in a
play, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's the moment of catharsis, where every
emotion
that has been bottled up finally
gets released.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this
moment since
tasting the bitter sting of
defeat in the last race.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But today is the day of my redemption,
and all
shall witness my rise from the
ashes!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: The time is come! The curtains rise!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
